verdict.rationale: Unleash documents its own self-hosted deployment (Open Source or Enterprise via Docker), so users decide where their data lives. Edge keeps targeting PII inside the Edge node rather than sending it to Unleash Cloud, and external metrics stay in the user's own Prometheus or VictoriaMetrics. However, nothing in the evidence shows a region or residency choice for the hosted Unleash Cloud offering. Missing for 10: documented cloud region/data-residency selection (e.g. EU/US hosting), residency compliance documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: This guide helps you set up Unleash Open Source or Unleash Enterprise in your own environment using Docker.
user data (PII) used for targeting rules (like user IDs, emails, or IPs) is processed within the Edge node and never sent to the Unleash Cloud or your upstream instance
External metrics are queried at read time from your existing Prometheus or VictoriaMetrics instance. The data stays in your system.
